guide: This turns the AI into an interviewer, so it asks you questions before it builds anything. You need ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code, plus a few minutes to answer questions.
1. Open ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code and say what you want in one rough sentence, without describing how it should work.
1. Tell the assistant not to build anything yet and to ask you questions one at a time instead.
1. Answer in plain words, including who it is for, what it should do, and what "done" looks like.
1. Tell it to point out anything you have not decided, such as where the data lives, who can see it, and what happens when something fails.
1. Ask it to write a short spec in your own words and read it back to you.
1. Correct anything wrong in the spec, then tell it to build from the spec.
1. Test the result, and when something is off, answer one more round of its questions rather than rewriting your request.
Watch out: if you let it start building after your first sentence, it fills every gap with a guess, so keep the "do not build yet" instruction in place until you have approved the spec.

```
You are my interviewer before you are my builder. I want to make: <one-sentence idea>.
Do not write any code or produce the final thing yet. Ask me questions one at a time, waiting for my answer each time. Cover who it is for, what it must do, what it must never do, the tools and accounts I already have (<tools I use, e.g. Google Drive, Notion, Telegram, Vercel>), where the data comes from and goes, and what could go wrong. If an answer is vague, ask a follow-up. Stop asking when you could build it without guessing, and tell me when you reach that point.
Then write a plain-English spec of no more than one page: the goal, the steps in order, the tools involved, and anything still undecided. Ask me to confirm or correct it. Only after I say "approved" should you build it, step by step, telling me how to test each step.
My experience level is <beginner / some coding>. Use British spelling and avoid jargon.
```
I only had the title, hook and a one-line description of the post. The steps are the general interview-first method, not anything specific from the slides.
